{{Quote|Hey Three-Five, check it out: commandos.''"<br />"''If they're anything as good as I hear, they can practically win the war themselves&hellip;|[[17]] and Three-Five, upon spotting Boss|<ref name="Republic Commando" />}}
'''Three-Five''', also known as '''35''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who fought in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], Three-Five and 17 were defending the rear approach to a barricade that was being defended by other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] against Separatist [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] encountered the two [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] shortly before the [[Battle droid/Legends|droids]] blew through a wall. Boss, Three-Five, and the other surviving clones held off the assaulting [[Droid/Legends|droids]], pushing them back to a Separatist gun emplacement.

==Biography==
Three-Five, also known as 35, was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]<ref name="Republic Commando" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="DB" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Clone Troopers" /> The clone served as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and a separatist group known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When the Republic [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|invaded]] the Separatist planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]<ref name="Republic Commando" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NECage">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Three-Five was part of the deployed forces.<ref name="Republic Commando" />

While on Geonosis, clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] Three-Five and [[17]] were guarding the rear entrance to a barricade that was being defended internally by other troopers against advancing [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] when the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] approached the group. Trooper 17, noticing the [[Commando/Legends|commando]], pointed out his presence to Three-Five. Seeing Boss, Three-Five expressed how commandos could win the war if they were as highly skilled as was rumored. As Boss reached the group, Separatist [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] blew through a wall to avoid the barricade, [[Death/Legends|killing]] one of the clone troopers. Trooper Three-Five and the other surviving clones engaged the attacking [[Battle droid/Legends|droids]], pushing them back to a Separatist gun emplacement.<ref name="Republic Commando" />

==Personality and traits==
Like all clones of Jango Fett,<ref name="DB" /> Three-Five stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Troopers" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> They held great respect for clone commandos, remarking that the specialist clones were highly capable in battle upon sighting commando Boss on Geonosis.<ref name="Republic Commando" />

==Equipment==
Three-Five wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]<ref name="Republic Commando" /><ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> and was armed with a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]],<ref name="Republic Commando" /><ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> customary of Republic clone troopers at the beginning of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Republic Commando" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clone trooper Three-Five appeared in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|first-person shooter]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'',<ref name="Republic Commando" /> released in [[2005]].<ref name="Amazon">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2022|Sith Unseen: A Retrospective}}</ref> The character was voiced by [[Roger Jackson]].<ref name="Republic Commando" />
